verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own docs say AuthKit can enroll users in multi-factor authentication, enabled from the dashboard's Authentication page, and pricing lists MFA as included in AuthKit. The evidence never names TOTP authenticator apps, backup codes, or step-up enforcement. missing for 10: explicit TOTP authenticator-app support, backup/recovery codes, step-up MFA enforcement for sensitive actions, ability to require MFA org-wide, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can require multi-factor authentication with TOTP authenticator apps and backup codes, with step-up enforcement where needed

citations.quote: Enroll users in multi-factor authentication for an additional layer of security. MFA can be enabled via the Authentication page in the WorkOS dashboard.
AuthKit includes email + password, social login, passkeys, MFA, magic auth, and enterprise SSO — all from one integration.
